# Contents
::: {.lead}
Every tutorial in the course, topic by topic. Within a topic the tutorials
are listed alphabetically.
:::

[← Back to Course 3 — Mathematical & Statistical Methods](index.qmd)

## Topic 1 · Linear Algebra & Matrices {#linear-algebra-matrix}

Eigenvalues, SVD, positive definite matrices, Perron-Frobenius, graph Laplacians. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/linear-algebra-matrix/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-linear-algebra-matrix .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 2 · Optimization & Numerical Methods {#optimization-numerical-methods}

Convex optimisation, LP, dynamic programming, gradient methods, fixed-point. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/optimization-numerical-methods/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-optimization-numerical-methods .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 3 · Information Theory {#information-theory}

Entropy, mutual information, KL divergence, channel capacity, rate-distortion. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/information-theory/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-information-theory .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 4 · Statistical Foundations {#statistical-foundations}

Probability, inference, hypothesis testing, regression, nonparametrics. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/statistical-foundations/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-statistical-foundations .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 5 · Bayesian Methods {#bayesian-methods}

Conjugate priors, MCMC, Stan, hierarchical models, Bayesian computation. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/bayesian-methods/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-bayesian-methods .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 6 · Causal Inference {#causal-inference}

DAGs, potential outcomes, DiD, IV, RDD, synthetic control. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/causal-inference/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-causal-inference .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 7 · Time Series & Econometrics {#time-series-econometrics}

ARIMA, VAR, cointegration, GARCH, structural breaks, panel data. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/time-series-econometrics/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-time-series-econometrics .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 8 · Network Science {#network-science}

Random graphs, centrality, community detection, epidemics, igraph/tidygraph. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/network-science/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-network-science .course-contents}
:::
